modalities.evidence: fMRI data of long-term memory retrieval

output.population: children (aged 10-12), adolescents (aged 14-16), and young adults (aged 20-35 years); 62 participants
output.summary: Functional MRI during autobiographical, episodic, and semantic long-term memory retrieval in children, adolescents, and young adults, using a previously published paradigm.
